asideNextText: Publishing content? Check its length with the word counter.
asideText: The preview renders locally from your input. Nothing is sent or stored anywhere.

faq.a: Google typically shows around 50-60 characters of the title and about 150-160 of the description, but it varies by device and pixel width. This tool flags when you go over common limits.
faq.q: How long should my title and description be?

faq.a: No. Everything renders locally in your browser from the text you type. Nothing is uploaded.
It is an approximation using common character limits. Google may rewrite titles and descriptions, so treat this as a planning preview, not a guarantee.
